description: Matteo Giacomo Prina of Accademia Europea publishes hourly solar-PV profiles for five PLANtoACT regions and four deployment categories: residential rooftop, commercial rooftop, utility tracking and agrivoltaics. PVGIS SARAH-3 simulations for nominal 1-kWp crystalline-silicon installations combine representative tilt, azimuth and tracking configurations. Ten years of inputs are normalised and corrected to preserve average equivalent full-load hours. The source uses representative coordinates for Lombardia, Alba Iulia, Oberland, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes and Porto, without establishing spatial averages across all installations. Five ZIP archives provide CSV and text profiles, JSON metadata and supporting outputs, freely under CC BY 4.0. The source identifies energy planning and capacity-expansion modelling as uses. A limitation is that the 8,784-hour option duplicates the final 24 hours of the 8,760-hour profile; it is not an observed leap year. Exact input years remain unspecified in the description. The related PLANtoACT building-stock record is another project input, with no equivalence claimed.
